beta_phi_extension.reason: The frozen allocation equation has no separate beta_Phi parameter. coupling_strength is its only posterior-coupling coefficient, so adding a second beta would change the frozen parameterization.

classification_rule.eventual_recovery_definition: First post-withdrawal position at which abs(logit(qT)-logit(qO)) is at most epsilon for k consecutive slices; epsilon and k are selected from the public census by the frozen rule below.

fingerprint.material_cue_response: max cue-period qT minus first-slice qT >= 0.10
fingerprint.no_continuing_congruent_evidence: zero delivered confirming-channel token-1 observations after cue withdrawal
fingerprint.oracle_relative_area: A_M_transparent exceeds the frozen q95 of coupling-zero safe original-grid worlds

classification_rule.material_metastability: world fingerprint rate >= 0.10, mean transparent-minus-represented A_M > 0, and eventual recovery among fingerprint-eligible worlds >= 0.80
classification_rule.null: Neither mean A_feedback nor mean transparent-minus-represented A_M is positive.
classification_rule.panel_selection: Within each class, select the first cell in the committed lexicographic parameter order. Never select by largest effect.
classification_rule.pathological_nonqualifying: The cell has material cue response and oracle-relative area in at least 10% of worlds but fails recovery, continuing-danger, continuing-evidence, oracle-truth, feedback-necessity, or transparency-dependence requirements.

recovery_parameter_selection.rule: Choose the first (epsilon ascending, then k in listed order) for which at least 80% of safe coupling-zero original-grid worlds attain sustained agreement. If none qualifies, use no recovery definition, classify no cell as material_metastability, and report unattainability.

classification_rule.weak: Not material or pathological, but mean A_feedback > 0 and mean transparent-minus-represented A_M > 0.

h_excess: Retired as a classifier; raw H and historical H_excess remain descriptive.
